reactions.text: These are two different problems — keep them as separate entries, don't fold them together. The first one is real and I can give you a time: last Thursday I had nine source tabs open before a conversion session and lost the exact one I needed, spent ten minutes hunting for it. The second — directors re-adding things already in the library — that's Maya's claim, and her 'I'd bet anything every director has this' is opinion, not a time it happened to her. Mark P1 first-hand with my Thursday instance, mark the P2 'bet anything' line as opinion (not established fact), and leave the are-they-the-same dispute open rather than deciding it.
